question: Can the 12DP summer-endpoint gap be narrowed without inventing a universal modern rounding rule, by testing the constant fractional-threshold class and then separating the directly attested pre-1578 Nanjing 59-ke endpoint from the C-II-N interior integer-threshold layer?

nanjing_official_endpoint.date: 1447 / 正統十二年十一月甲寅
nanjing_official_endpoint.institutional_phrase_scope: 宮禁及官府漏箭 are explicitly described as Nanjing old style in the reviewed official record

ming_restoration_policy.direct_policy_result: Future calendar production ordered to follow the Hongwu/Yongle old style.

later_explanatory_control.role: Explains early-Ming Datong day/night calibration as changed to Nanjing clepsydra, with 59/41 versus Yandu Shoushi 62/38.

constant_fractional_threshold_test.tested_rule_class: Q_t(x)=floor(x)+1 when fractional_part(x)>=t, otherwise floor(x), with one constant t used globally
constant_fractional_threshold_test.structural_target_scope: The clean stepped Nanjing-family replay used in 12DP; this is a mechanical model-class test, not a claim that a pre-1578 text states Q_t.

floor.effective_behavior: never round a positive fraction upward

constant_fractional_threshold_test.firewall: This disproves only the single constant fractional-threshold mapping class. It does not prove which historical endpoint anchoring, cap, table lookup, term-specific rule, or editorial recomposition was used.

composite_mechanism_candidate.endpoint_component: Direct 1447 official Nanjing solstitial 59-ke standard, with 41 only as hundred-ke complement in that memorial
composite_mechanism_candidate.later_explanatory_context: Post-1578 Xing Yunlu received explanation associates early-Ming Datong with Nanjing clepsydra 59/41; chronology forbids ancestry promotion.
composite_mechanism_candidate.interpretation: The 59 endpoint is better modeled as an independently attested regional/institutional endpoint layer than forced through the same fractional reduction used to describe C-II-N interior crossings. This removes the endpoint contradiction at mechanism level without pretending that the exact historical recomposition instruction has been found.

transmission_impact.narrowed_missing_link: Find a pre-1578 Chinese source that explicitly binds the Nanjing/Datong daily whole-ke selection layer to the 59-ke solstitial standard and, ideally, preserves the Sanming/Yueling 大寒十三後 / 雨水後四日 fingerprint.

next_gate: Search pre-1578 Chinese Nanjing/Datong calendars, Tongshu/almanacs, clepsydra/change-arrow manuals or official calendar texts for an explicit rule binding the interior whole-ke thresholds to the 59-ke endpoint.
Prioritize witnesses that also reproduce the high-information Sanming/Yueling 大寒十三後 and 雨水後四日 transition fingerprint.
Continue independent Chinese physical-carrier search for C-II-N / 晨昏立成.
Keep NLC call 14202 reproduction route parallel behind the identity/payment/authorization firewall; do not submit an external request without user action.
